items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: I thought the fact there was Johnny D. Dwight in the recording orchestra, I could get, you know, make a lot of money.

ctx.x: Well, when did your- did you use a megaphone right from the first with your band, or when did that start?

Well, I first heard singing. When I had the Dixieland band, we didn't sing. But when I'd go to Biloxi, I'd bring ten men, see? Well, I'd bring ten men, and we'd play a few, you know, we had a big crystal ball, we'd put the lights out, that's all the entertainment we had. That's all the set you had. That's all we had. We didn't have any intermission. He didn't want any intermission, so instead of playing four hours, we played three. We didn't want any intermission. And we sent a couple of cases to post the dance…
So you had a ten piece orchestra that you were calling your recording orchestra, besides your...
